name: Full-Curve Side Profile (Chest, Belly & Butt)
summary: Full-bodied side profile with forward chest/belly protrusion and rear gluteal depth.
style_goal: Streamline overall profile volume with structured tailored lines, dark tones, and open vertical drape.

tops.reason: Drapes chest and belly without constriction.

bottoms.reason: Skims comfortably past rear and hips.

necklines.reason: Opens up upper neck area visually.

dresses.reason: Flows cleanly from under bust to ankle.

reasoning.overall: Structured tailoring, open V-necks, and dark vertical columns streamline full-curve profiles.

styling_tips: Stick to matte fabrics like wool, crepe, matte jersey, or linen-cotton blends.
Pair dark monochrome base layers with an open blazer.
